## Specific task description

Task instruction: Move the hand-size bright blue stapler to the Red mat

Task description: The target is the long bright blue stapler at the lower left of the head-camera view; the destination is the red rectangular mat above and to its right. The blue toy car above it is not the target.

Success criteria: Position the stapler near the center of the red mat at mat-surface height and in the specified placement pose, with both grippers open. The materials do not specify the visible orientation corresponding to that pose, so moving it onto the red mat alone cannot confirm completion.

## Execution tips

- Approach from above and grip the middle of the stapler body across its short axis, on relatively flat areas near the base. Avoid gripping only the moving top cover, which could leave the base hanging or open the body.
- Set the gripper opening slightly wider than the grasp width. Before closing, confirm that the fingers are actually on opposite sides of the body and the pads have sufficient contact area, avoiding pressing only the cover or hitting the table.
- If reorienting, turn it slightly where the body is clear of the table and has room around it, reducing the risk of dragging the base across the table or catching the edge of the red mat.
- Lower in small steps near the red mat, confirm the base is supported before releasing, and watch whether the pads shift the stapler as they open.
